data_role.en: Uses existing decision and intent-routing benchmarks
data_role.zh: 使用已有决策与意图路由基准

design.en: Compares frozen candidate logits with task-targeted fine-tuning and checks transfer to other capabilities.
design.zh: 对比冻结模型候选读出与针对性微调，并检查其他能力的迁移。

reading.en: Useful for separating readout changes from training gains; adaptation is most helpful for specific weaknesses.
reading.zh: 可区分读出变化与训练收益；针对具体短板的适配更有价值。

data_role.en: Converts existing visual tasks to candidate-choice workloads
data_role.zh: 将已有视觉任务转换为候选选择任务

design.en: Controls task adaptation and decision-head choice separately from prefix reuse and batching.
design.zh: 将任务适配、决策头与前缀复用、批处理分别控制。

reading.en: Shared execution improves efficiency; the dedicated head has no consistent accuracy advantage.
reading.zh: 共享执行提高效率；专用决策头没有稳定的准确率优势。

data_role.en: Uses recognition and visual-question benchmarks
data_role.zh: 使用图像识别与视觉问答基准

design.en: Compares frozen inference, language-side adaptation and matched prompt-only controls.
design.zh: 对比冻结推理、语言侧适配与匹配的纯提示对照。

reading.en: Accuracy gains depend on adaptation and task; valid output does not establish calibrated probabilities.
reading.zh: 准确率收益依赖适配与任务；输出合法不代表概率已校准。

source_section: Experimental setup and matched prompt-only follow-up

data_role.en: Introduces a constructed-probability dataset
data_role.zh: 提出真概率已知的构造数据集

design.en: Queries the same events through Choice, Noul and Score; evaluates full probability distributions.
design.zh: 对同一事件调用 Choice、Noul、Score，并评价完整概率分布。

reading.en: Tests probability meaning directly; it answers a different question from classification accuracy.
reading.zh: 直接检验概率的数值含义，不能用分类准确率替代。

data_role.en: Introduces typed-request adversarial scenarios
data_role.zh: 提出类型化请求的对抗场景基准

design.en: Compares single-field edits against the clean decision and an identical-request noise baseline.
design.zh: 将单字段编辑与干净决策、完全相同请求的重复噪声对比。

reading.en: Measures decision changes under perturbation; flips are not automatically errors against independent labels.
reading.zh: 衡量扰动下的决策变化；翻转不自动等于独立真值上的错误。

data_role.en: Combines existing public datasets; selected examples shown
data_role.zh: 组合已有公开数据集；此处列举部分

design.en: Uses fixed task templates to compare classification, calibration and selective prediction across primitives.
design.zh: 采用固定任务模板，比较不同原语的分类、校准与选择性预测。

reading.en: Broad task coverage reveals interface-dependent behavior; task distributions and split choices still differ.
reading.zh: 广泛任务覆盖显示接口依赖行为，但任务分布与划分方式并不相同。

data_role.en: Reuses human-disagreement annotations
data_role.zh: 使用人类意见分歧标注

design.en: Separates easier and harder agreement cases and corrects sampling bias in calibration estimates.
design.zh: 分开评估不同分歧程度，并校正校准估计的采样偏差。

reading.en: Assesses confidence against human agreement; disagreement is not a single objective correctness label.
reading.zh: 检验置信度与人类一致程度的关系；分歧不等于单一客观正误标签。

data_role.en: Uses original labels from agent-security benchmarks
data_role.zh: 使用代理安全基准的原始标签

design.en: Separates calibration, threshold selection and held-out testing; compares attack groups and escalation policies.
design.zh: 分离校准、阈值选择与留出测试，比较攻击组与升级策略。

reading.en: Aggregate calibration can mask unsafe misses in particular groups; strict risk constraints limit automatic approval.
reading.zh: 总体校准可能掩盖特定攻击组的漏检；严格风险约束限制自动放行。

data_role.en: Uses original and study-revised behavior labels
data_role.zh: 结合原始标签与研究修订的行为标签

design.en: Applies a common risk rubric and reports detection quality, valid-result coverage and inference cost separately.
design.zh: 统一风险标准，分别报告检测质量、有效结果覆盖和推理成本。

reading.en: Label revisions matter when comparing studies; retrospective trace classification is not online blocking.
reading.zh: 跨研究比较需核对标签修订；事后轨迹分类不等于在线阻断。

data_role.en: Reuses code examples and benchmark CWE labels
data_role.zh: 使用已有代码样本与基准 CWE 标签

design.en: Holds the repair model fixed while changing the weakness classifier; evaluates with the Insecure Code Detector.
design.zh: 固定修复模型，改变弱点分类器，再用 Insecure Code Detector 评价。

reading.en: Detector-measured security improves; the experiment does not prove all vulnerabilities are removed or functionality preserved.
reading.zh: 检测器测得的安全性改善，不代表所有漏洞消失或功能完全保持。

data_role.en: Uses a small pilot from an existing intrusion dataset
data_role.zh: 从已有入侵数据集开展小规模试验

design.en: Compares typed intrusion decisions under limited labels; distinguish the paper snapshot from later repository runs.
design.zh: 比较有限标签下的类型化入侵决策；区分论文快照与仓库后续实验。

reading.en: Useful as an initial IDS study, with live-traffic validity and deployment false alarms still unestablished.
reading.zh: 可作为初步 IDS 研究，真实流量有效性与部署误报仍待验证。

data_role.en: Builds simulated attack and fault scenarios
data_role.zh: 构造仿真攻击与故障场景

design.en: Tests sealed rounds and transfer networks; sends uncertain or rule-disagreed cases to an LLM reviewer.
design.zh: 使用封闭轮次与迁移网络测试，将不确定或规则不一致的案例交给 LLM 复核。

reading.en: Rule agreement can reduce review workload; evidence is from simulation rather than an operating water utility.
reading.zh: 规则一致性门控可减少复核负载；证据来自仿真而非实际供水运行。

data_role.en: Uses released CSS task splits with adjudicated labels; compares native decision probabilities with verbalized LLM confidence.
data_role.zh: 使用公开社科任务划分与裁定标签；区分原生决策概率和大模型口述置信度。

design.en: 18 tasks and 7,977 items; matched prompts, open-model ablations, per-task calibration and coverage–accuracy curves.
design.zh: 18 个任务、7,977 条样本；匹配提示，开放模型消融，逐任务校准与覆盖率—准确率曲线。

reading.en: An aggregate calibration advantage does not justify one automation threshold across constructs; benchmark labels do not capture all annotator disagreement.
reading.zh: 总体校准优势不支持跨任务共用自动化阈值；基准裁定标签也不完全代表标注分歧。

data_role.en: Uses restricted crash narratives and a weighted human-reference audit; aggregate outputs and analysis code are reported released.
data_role.zh: 使用受限事故叙事和加权人工审计；论文声明公开聚合结果与分析代码。

design.en: 2,416 usable human judgments; recalibration fits and tests on separate narrative halves with repeated splits, avoiding judgment-level leakage.
design.zh: 2,416 条可用人工判断；按叙事划分拟合和测试集并重复切分，避免同一叙事的判断跨组泄漏。

reading.en: Internal split evaluation supports within-corpus recalibration, not transfer to a new region or time period. Raw narratives are restricted; row-level audit release remains conditional.
reading.zh: 内部划分支持同语料后校准，不能证明跨地区或时间迁移。原始叙事受限，逐项审计数据公开仍有条件。

source_section: Section 3, Eq. 20; Sections 4.2–4.4; Data and code availability

data_role.en: Constructs source-grounded scientific cases with separate semantic and downstream references.
data_role.zh: 构造有来源依据的科学案例，分别提供语义选择与下游结果参照。

design.en: Ten cases, twenty choices, twelve configurations and five repeats; reports planned-request coverage separately from successful-response accuracy.
design.zh: 十个案例、二十个选择、十二种配置、五次重复；区分计划请求覆盖率与成功响应准确率。

reading.en: Repeats estimate variability on the same cases, not a larger independent sample. Useful as an evaluation protocol, not evidence of broad scientific or security competence.
reading.zh: 重复调用只估计同批案例的波动，不扩大独立样本。可借鉴评测协议，不能据此证明广泛科学或安全能力。

data_role.en: Constructed judgment batteries and an intent-classification subset
data_role.zh: 自建裁判测试集与意图分类子集

design.en: Separates client wall time, provider fields and access-layer truncation; pairs judge and LLM errors on identical items.
design.zh: 区分客户端计时、服务自报字段与接入层截断；在相同样本上配对比较裁判和大模型错误。

reading.en: Many failure analyses concern Laya, not Jev. Small samples, missing artifacts and multiplicity limit conclusions; autonomous long-horizon runs were not executed.
reading.zh: Laya 的失败不能直接归于 Jev；时延样本有限，部分统计缺可核验产物，多重校正后相关性未确立，未执行自主长流程。

data_role.en: Existing public datasets or released benchmark artifacts
data_role.zh: 已有公开数据或发布的基准工件

design.en: Prior normalization and cyclic option rotations; the public JevBench subset scores 213 of 231 items.
design.zh: 先验归一化与循环选项置换；公开 JevBench 子集评估 231 项中的 213 项。

reading.en: No weight training, but prior strength and temperature use labels. Extra rotations cost forwards; the serving stopping bound needs separate selection and certification data.
reading.zh: 没有权重训练，但先验强度和温度使用标签；置换增加前向成本，服务停止界限需区分选择集与认证集。

data_role.en: Existing public datasets or released benchmark artifacts
data_role.zh: 已有公开数据或发布的基准工件

design.en: Validation-calibrated CPU gate and Laya cascade; tests clean held-out prompts, false positives and cross-domain transfer.
design.zh: 在验证集校准 CPU 门控与 Laya 级联，测试干净留出提示、误报与跨域迁移。

reading.en: In-domain accuracy does not establish OOD robustness; paper separates specialization loss and replay recovery. Hardware and end-to-end serial timing must remain explicit.
reading.zh: 域内准确率不能替代域外鲁棒性；论文区分专门化损失和回放恢复，且必须保留硬件与串行端到端计时条件。

data_role.en: Existing public datasets or released benchmark artifacts
data_role.zh: 已有公开数据或发布的基准工件

design.en: Benchmark-trained encoder with option-set attention and per-type temperature scaling; includes a verbatim contamination audit.
design.zh: 在基准训练集训练选项集合注意力编码器并按类型温度校准，另做逐字污染审计。

reading.en: Hosted Jev numbers come from third parties with different prompts and samples; this is not a matched zero-shot comparison.
reading.zh: 托管 Jev 数字来自第三方、提示与样本不同，不是匹配的零样本对照。

data_role.en: Source-defined evaluation corpus; see linked original source for constituent datasets and splits.
data_role.zh: 原文定义的评测资料；组成数据集和划分见链接原始来源。

design.en: 300 calibration and 589 test texts across AG News, DBpedia, Emotion and TREC; 23,932 predictions per model, paired by text with calibration-only thresholds.
design.zh: AG News、DBpedia、Emotion、TREC 共 300 条校准与 589 条测试文本；每模型 23,932 次预测，按文本配对，阈值只用校准集选择。

reading.en: On five-candidate TREC, native Laya detects 97.2% of omissions but rejects 69.7% of valid controls; Jev gives 24.8%/0.0%. Threshold selection changes the operating points without guaranteeing population risk.
reading.zh: TREC 五候选下 Laya 原生遗漏检测／错误拒答为 97.2%／69.7%，Jev 为 24.8%／0.0%。校准阈值改变运行点，但不构成总体风险保证。

data_role.en: Source-defined evaluation corpus; see linked original source for constituent datasets and splits.
data_role.zh: 原文定义的评测资料；组成数据集和划分见链接原始来源。

design.en: Fully paired evaluation on Dynamic (4,120), MHS (3,203), HateXplain (1,924) and HateCheck (3,728); 10,000 linked-group bootstrap draws with family-wise Bonferroni adjustment.
design.zh: 在 Dynamic 4,120、MHS 3,203、HateXplain 1,924、HateCheck 3,728 条文本上完全配对；按关联组做 10,000 次 bootstrap 并按比较族 Bonferroni 调整。

reading.en: Decomposition improves 6/30 comparisons and worsens 11/30. Jev approaches commercial quality cheaply on diagnostic HateCheck, but this does not establish the same trade-off on everyday moderation traffic.
reading.zh: 问题分解在 30 组对照中改善 6 组、恶化 11 组。Jev 在诊断性 HateCheck 上以较低费用接近商业模型，但不能直接外推日常审核流量。

data_role.en: Source-defined evaluation corpus; see linked original source for constituent datasets and splits.
data_role.zh: 原文定义的评测资料；组成数据集和划分见链接原始来源。

design.en: 170,185 questions over 14 tasks; separate training, development, calibration and 21,634-question test splits grouped by source. Matching backbones and training budgets compare candidate scoring with one-token generation.
design.zh: 14 项任务共 170,185 个问题；训练、开发、校准和 21,634 题测试独立，按来源组划分。同骨干同训练预算比较候选评分与单 token 生成。

reading.en: Accuracy closely matches generative SFT with smaller measured peak memory. Temperature scaling improves NLL but worsens ECE and Brier on security tests; new-source traffic false positives remain high.
reading.zh: 准确率接近生成式监督微调，实测峰值显存较小。安全测试中温度缩放改善 NLL，却恶化 ECE 与 Brier；新来源流量误报仍高。

data_role.en: Original evaluation corpus or source-defined study suite
data_role.zh: 原始评测语料或论文定义的研究集合

design.en: 182M-parameter model; sequential-head and REINFORCE controls, three seeds per recipe and 4,275 questions across seven tracks.
design.zh: 182M 参数模型；对照顺序读出头与 REINFORCE，每方案三个种子，在七主题共 4,275 题上评估。

reading.en: Later runs were shaped by earlier test results in three tracks; first-run unseen support questions show smooth ECE rising from 0.027 to 0.045 after temperature scaling.
reading.zh: 后三个相关主题的训练受先前测试结果影响；首轮未见支持问题上，温度缩放使 smooth ECE 从 0.027 升至 0.045。

data_role.en: Original evaluation corpus or source-defined study suite
data_role.zh: 原始评测语料或论文定义的研究集合

design.en: Human-coded references from seven published studies; matched GPT-6 Luna and Qwen comparisons, paired bootstrap and separate single-call versus order-averaged calibration.
design.zh: 以七项已发表研究的人类编码为参考；匹配 GPT-6 Luna、Qwen 对照，配对 bootstrap，并区分单次与交换顺序平均后的概率校准。

reading.en: Luna costs use posted batch/standard rates, while latency uses synchronous calls; Qwen pricing describes its served route. Jev calibration exceeds Luna token readouts but not consistently Qwen.
reading.zh: Luna 费用按公布的批处理／标准费率计算，时延来自同步请求；Qwen 费用对应托管路由。Jev 校准优于 Luna token 读出，对 Qwen 则无一致优势。

source_section: Table 2, calibration analysis and Appendix H; PDF pp. 6–18

data_role.en: Original evaluation corpus or source-defined study suite
data_role.zh: 原始评测语料或论文定义的研究集合

design.en: 139 paper families, 429 coded scopes, independent coding and bounded event-model experiments with execution-time replay.
design.zh: 139 个论文族、429 个编码范围，结合独立编码与执行时间回放的事件模型实验。

reading.en: Only four of fifty timing-fit claims have matched measurement. Replayed execution and one random stream limit the scope of the measured queueing results.
reading.zh: 50 项时序适配主张中有 4 项提供匹配测量；排队实验使用执行回放和单一随机流，结论对应该事件模型。

data_role.en: Original evaluation corpus or source-defined study suite
data_role.zh: 原始评测语料或论文定义的研究集合

design.en: 800 structural queries; matched graph/text contrasts on ogbn-arxiv and STaRK-Prime; four construction tasks with ten instances each and fixed-rule/proposal controls.
design.zh: 800 个结构查询；ogbn-arxiv、STaRK-Prime 图文匹配对照；四项构造任务各十实例，包含固定规则及提案池对照。

reading.en: Jev recognizes adjacency well but is weaker at exact degree and articulation. Shared graph context and single executions limit uncertainty estimates; proposal assistance changes several inputs together.
reading.zh: Jev 擅长邻接识别，精确度数与割点判断较弱。共享图上下文和单次执行影响不确定性估计；提案辅助同时改变多项输入。

data_role.en: Original evaluation corpus or source-defined study suite
data_role.zh: 原始评测语料或论文定义的研究集合

design.en: Official Jev and local NanoJev; three synthetic decision tasks with 200 states each and three repeats, plus controlled training and four defensive detection tasks.
design.zh: 比较官方 Jev 与本地 NanoJev；三个合成决策任务各 200 个状态、重复三次，另有可控训练和四项防御检测任务。

reading.en: High clean-task accuracy coexists with input-manipulation failures. Backdoor and membership results use controlled NanoJev data; factual knowledge probes are distinct from training membership.
reading.zh: 干净任务高准确率与输入操纵失效并存。后门及成员推断结论依赖 NanoJev 可控数据；事实知识探测与训练成员身份需分别解释。

source_section: Sections III–V, Tables I–III; PDF pp. 4–12

data_role.en: Original evaluation corpus or source-defined study suite
data_role.zh: 原始评测语料或论文定义的研究集合

design.en: Receive-antenna selection and 30 RAN-slicing instances over 21 feasible actions; exhaustive numerical references and client-observed latency.
design.zh: 接收天线选择，以及 21 个可行动作上的 30 个 RAN 切片实例；采用穷举数值参考与客户端观测时延。

reading.en: Antenna capacity loss is 20.19% for Jev versus 9.46% for the norm heuristic. Slicing utility regret is comparable to the tested LLMs at over 3.5 times lower median response latency.
reading.zh: 天线选择中 Jev 容量损失为 20.19%，范数启发式为 9.46%；切片效用遗憾接近所测 LLM，中位响应时延降低超过 3.5 倍。

data_role.en: Exact analytic targets and human vote distributions
data_role.zh: 精确解析目标与人类投票分布

design.en: Mirror-paired coin witnesses, three base-rate wordings, separately collected holdout repeats and 650 ChaosNLI/DICES items; clustered bootstrap.
design.zh: 镜像硬币证据、三种基率措辞、另行采集的留出重复及 650 条 ChaosNLI／DICES 样本；采用聚类 bootstrap。

reading.en: Normalized Noul reduces exact-target Brier error from 0.067 to 0.003. On disputed human labels neither primitive beats uniform prediction in the hardest strata; temperature calibration makes their average results similar.
reading.zh: 归一化 Noul 将精确目标 Brier 误差从 0.067 降至 0.003；在人类分歧最高的分层，两种接口均未胜过均匀预测，温度校准后总体结果接近。

data_role.en: 500 synthetic texts, 500 business documents and 127 court judgments
data_role.zh: 500 条合成文本、500 份商业文档和 127 份法院判决

design.en: Word-level F2/F1, PII leakage, paired document bootstrap, and 20 development documents per dataset for thresholds.
design.zh: 逐词 F2／F1、PII 泄漏、按文档配对 bootstrap；各数据集 20 份开发文档用于阈值选择。

reading.en: On judgments Jev F2 is 0.834 versus Haiku 0.819, with paired difference interval crossing zero; Jev recall is higher but F1 is lower. Initial test errors informed later prompt changes.
reading.zh: 判决文本上 Jev F2 为 0.834、Haiku 为 0.819，差值区间跨零；Jev 召回较高而 F1 较低。早期测试错误参与了后续提示修改。

data_role.en: Original evaluation corpus or source-defined study suite
data_role.zh: 原始评测语料或论文定义的研究集合

design.en: Ten models, three workloads and two runs per task; 10 hours and five million weighted tokens per run. Jev is evaluated on 1,000 ESCI and RAID items each.
design.zh: 十模型、三任务，每组合两次；每轮十小时、五百万加权 token。Jev 在 ESCI 与 RAID 各 1,000 条样本上评估。

reading.en: 48 of 60 artifact runs fall below the zero-shot confidence interval. Full-workload Jev costs are extrapolated; reported token/API cost excludes local compute, and two artifact runs provide limited variability evidence.
reading.zh: 60 次产物运行中 48 次低于零样本区间下界。Jev 全量费用来自外推；所报 token／API 费用不含本地计算，两次产物运行对变异的估计有限。

data_role.en: Original evaluation corpus or source-defined study suite
data_role.zh: 原始评测语料或论文定义的研究集合

design.en: 192 traces from 96 selected FinQA questions; 15 initial contrasts and a fresh 36-page follow-up labeled by one non-author reviewer; question-level bootstrap.
design.zh: 96 个筛选 FinQA 问题产生 192 条轨迹；15 组初始对照及 36 个新页面的后续对照，由一名非作者审核；按问题 bootstrap。

reading.en: Signed-number matching explains most recovery. Natural labels are assistant judgments; the fresh follow-up has one reviewer, and excluding one disputed case removes the net separation gain.
reading.zh: 带符号数字匹配解释了大部分恢复收益。自然轨迹标签来自助手判断；新样本仅一名审核者，排除一个争议案例即消除净分离收益。

source_section: Sections II–IV, Tables I–III; PDF pp. 2–8

data_role.en: Original evaluation corpus or source-defined study suite
data_role.zh: 原始评测语料或论文定义的研究集合

design.en: Six reasoning/code benchmarks plus WebSRC, three seeds, matched GPT workers; random-controller, GPT-controller and reader-removal ablations.
design.zh: 六个推理／代码基准加 WebSRC，三个种子、匹配 GPT 工作模型；含随机控制、GPT 控制和移除阅读器消融。

reading.en: The six-task mean is 93.97% versus DyLAN 93.12%. Token savings count GPT calls, not all local-model compute; latency includes controller and reader. This is Laya-based coordination, not a Jev API experiment.
reading.zh: 六任务均值为 93.97%，DyLAN 为 93.12%。节省量统计 GPT 调用 token，不含全部本地模型计算；时延包含控制器和阅读器。这是 Laya 协调实验，并非 Jev API 实验。

design.en: Formal relational semantics and synthetic 2,000-review workloads, 200 instances for main experiments and 50 for tuple-pricing comparisons.
design.zh: 关系代数形式化及每实例 2,000 条评论的合成工作负载；主要实验 200 实例，逐元组定价比较 50 实例。

reading.en: Simulation assumes calibrated Bernoulli labels and a perfect escalation judge in its main setting. Ratio-of-expectations quality is approximate; no real-engine Jev evaluation is reported.
reading.zh: 主要模拟假定校准 Bernoulli 标签与完美升级裁判。期望比值仅近似质量，未报告真实引擎上的 Jev 实测。

design.en: Jev/Laya shared compact inputs; fixed-rule-inventory contrasts, paired bootstrap, training-only PluRule test retrieval and leave-one-out OLID/HateXplain retrieval.
design.zh: Jev／Laya 共享紧凑输入，固定规则集合对照与配对 bootstrap；PluRule 测试仅从训练集检索，OLID／HateXplain 采用留一检索。

reading.en: PluRule held-out EMA improves by 5.20 points with precedents. External reference systems are not input-matched; leave-one-out retrieval is distinct from held-out deployment and intervals are not multiplicity-adjusted.
reading.zh: PluRule 留出测试中，先例使 EMA 提升 5.20 点。外部参照系统并非输入匹配对照；留一检索不同于独立部署，多重比较区间未经校正。

design.en: 12,800 training items, 10,027 test decisions from 59 sources, three seeds and matched-recipe single-pass controls; independent transfer and evidence-removal groups.
design.zh: 12,800 条训练、59 来源共 10,027 条测试决策，三个种子及匹配训练方案的单轮对照；区分迁移与证据移除组。

reading.en: Accuracy reaches 72.0% at 7.7 times one-loop GPU time. A larger single-pass reference is stronger per compute; confidence rises on wrong answers and ECE increases from loop 3 to 8.
reading.zh: 准确率达 72.0%，GPU 时间为单轮的 7.7 倍。较大单轮参照按计算预算更强；错误答案置信度也上升，ECE 从第三至第八轮变差。

design.en: 91 menu interventions across open decision-model families, with matched-cost cascades and a held-out 250-item CLINC150 test.
design.zh: 在开放决策模型族上开展 91 次菜单干预，比较匹配成本级联，并使用 250 条 CLINC150 留出测试。

reading.en: Section 3.2 computes accuracy by comparison with y(x), despite the zero-label claim. Gold-retaining menu curation and ranking stability do not establish deployable label-free accuracy; prose and abstract differ on dataset counts.
reading.zh: 第 3.2 节准确率计算仍与 y(x) 比较，与零标签主张不一致。保留正确标签的菜单构造及排序稳定不能证明可部署的无标签准确率；摘要与正文数据集计数也不一致。
